title: F08 — Issues and before/after
tagline: log an issue from the camera, surface it next session, close it by a verification photo as a before/after pair.
intro: Sprint S5 · 26h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: log an issue from the camera, surface it next session, close it by a verification photo as a before/after pair.
  • Demo — offline: issue logged by voice → re-checked next session → closed; the pair shows on the issue.
  • Demo — signed in: the issue and its pair appear on the second device.
  • Spec: 03, 12.3 dictation
